title: Quake done Quad
wikitext:
A run through single player Quake using various cheats:

* godmode
* host_framerate
* all weapons
* quad enabled

The point being: how fast can Quake be finished using "conventional" Quake cheats (excluding such bizarre things as noclip, for example.)

Only episodes 1-3 have been filmed from 3rd perspective.  I think all maps in all episodes were ran at least once.  More info soon.

Finish times off the top of my hand:

* E1M1: 13 sec.
* E2M1: 4 sec.

Download link soon (offline since qw.us went down but backed up somewhere).  AVI soon.  :)
